title: Crispi Buttermilk Chicken in Paprika Cracker Gravy
description: Thin chicken cutlets cook under paprika broth and are served with a smooth buttermilk gravy flavored with softened cracker crumbs.
equipment: Ninja Crispi PowerPod with US Bake preset

ingredients.name: unenhanced boneless skinless chicken breast
ingredients.note: Butterfly into cutlets, with no injected brine.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Choose plain meat-and-bone broth without a vegetable blend.

ingredients.name: finely crushed unsalted plain crackers
ingredients.note: Use plain dairy-free crackers; grind to fine crumbs.

steps.title: Set up the Crispi
steps.text: Use the room-temperature 6-cup Crispi glass container without an adapter. Leave out the crisper plate so the food sits in liquid. Load the container before starting the PowerPod and keep the storage lid off during cooking.

steps.title: Thin the cutlets
steps.text: Place {chicken} between sheets of parchment and tap the thick ends with a mallet until evenly 1/3 inch thick. Cut into smaller pieces if needed so the meat fits the glass in a shallow layer.

steps.title: Cover with seasoned broth
steps.text: Mix {broth}, {paprika} and {garlic} directly in the unheated glass. Slip the cutlets under the liquid and spread them out so broth can circulate.

steps.title: Poach on Bake
steps.text: Seat the PowerPod and select Bake. Start checking the thickest centers sideways at 12 minutes. Turn with silicone tongs and continue in 2–3 minute intervals until each reaches 165°F, usually 15–28 minutes total. Lift each cooked piece to a covered bowl with some broth.

steps.title: Soften the cracker crumbs
steps.text: Transfer the remaining cooking broth to the HexClad, whisk in {crumbs} and bring to a full boil. Reduce to a simmer for 2 minutes. Press through a sieve and return the smooth base to the skillet.

steps.title: Mix the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Whisk the freshly stirred slurry into the simmering sauce and stir for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Temper the buttermilk
steps.text: Remove the skillet from the heat. Whisk a little warm gravy into {buttermilk}, then gently stir the mixture back into the pan.

steps.title: Give each cutlet extra gravy
steps.text: Slice the chicken across the grain. Set the slices into a pool of gravy and spoon a second layer over the cut faces.

notes: Make ahead: Flatten the chicken the night before and refrigerate covered. Grind the crackers and keep dry until making the gravy. Option A uses tangy buttermilk. For gentler Option B, replace it with plain milk. Unsweetened oat milk also works as a dairy-free replacement. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the chicken in the paprika gravy for up to 2 months; add buttermilk after reheating to reduce separation. Fridge reheat: Transfer a single portion with its sauce to a shallow covered oven-safe dish separate from the Crispi glass. Install the APO Gen 1 bottom drip pan. Preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Set the probe to 165°F at the coldest center. Start checking at 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Use the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 209 kcal, 34.0 g protein, 6.4 g total carbohydrate, 4.2 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 135 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.

steps.title: Allow for oven timing
steps.text: Use the first time given as a check. A covered metal dish may need 3–10 minutes longer; check tenderness or the center temperature every 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the covered baking dish
steps.text: Preheat Samsung Bake to 350°F. Use a small metal baking dish and a fitted cover or foil to retain moisture.
